title: REFORGE: LLM-Assisted RTL Bug Repair with Structured Context and Verification Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2611.33748v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can write and repair RTL, but successful compilation or testbench execution does not establish defect removal, behavioral preservation, security, or implementation feasibility. Existing LLM-based RTL repair methods often report a single repair rate without retaining separate evidence for these properties, limiting reproducible comparison and integration into hardware design flows. We present REFORGE, which, to our knowledge, is the first LLM-assisted RTL repair framework that maintains and accumulates structured repair evidence across iterations, allowing it to generate fixes that satisfy multiple objectives simultaneously, including functionality, behavioral equivalence, security, and cost efficiency. REFORGE profiles buggy RTL, identifies structural and security-relevant features, localizes failing behavior, and uses verification-guided diagnosis to generate complete RTL repair variants. translated_title: REFORGE：基于结构化上下文与验证反馈的LLM辅助RTL缺陷修复
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）能够编写和修复RTL代码，但编译成功或测试平台执行成功并不能证明缺陷已被消除、行为得以保持、安全性得到保障或实现具有可行性。现有的基于LLM的RTL修复方法通常只报告单一的修复率，而不保留针对这些属性的独立证据，这限制了可复现的比较以及与硬件设计流程的集成。据我们所知，我们提出的REFORGE是首个在迭代过程中维护并积累结构化修复证据的LLM辅助RTL修复框架，使其能够生成同时满足多个目标的修复方案，包括功能性、行为等价性、安全性和成本效率。REFORGE对有缺陷的RTL进行特征分析，识别结构和安全相关特征，定位失效行为，并利用验证引导的诊断来生成完整的RTL修复变体。每个变体……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: REFORGE是首个通过跨迭代维护与积累结构化修复证据、结合验证引导诊断的LLM辅助RTL缺陷修复框架，能够生成同时满足功能性、行为等价性、安全性和成本效率等多目标的完整RTL修复方案。
en_tdlr: REFORGE is the first LLM-assisted RTL bug repair framework that maintains and accumulates structured repair evidence across iterations with verification-guided diagnosis, generating complete fixes that simultaneously satisfy functionality, behavioral equivalence, security, and cost efficiency objectives.
